jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management
jobs.description:
Job Description
Are you ready to take your career Global?
The senior manager, product management will lead product strategy, roadmap development, and product management execution for a strategic component of the Genius portfolio , one of Global Payments' flagship commerce and software platforms.

The Genius portfolio powers integrated point-of-sale, digital commerce, and customer engagement experiences that help businesses serve their customers more effectively across physical and digital channels. As part of this organization, you will be responsible for a portfolio that combines foundational commerce platform capabilities with highly visible customer-facing experiences, including self-service ordering, mobile applications, web ordering, and emerging digital engagement solutions.

You will lead a team of Product Managers and partner closely with Engineering, Product Delivery, UX, Sales, Customer Success, and customers to define and execute a product vision that balances platform stability, operational excellence, user experience modernization, innovation, and long-term business growth.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of a highly strategic product portfolio while building scalable product management practices, strengthening product discipline, and delivering market-leading customer experiences.

What you'll own:
- Lead and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for a portfolio of point-of-sale and digital commerce products. Establish clear ownership, accountability, product management best practices, and a culture focused on customer outcomes, innovation, and execution excellence.

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for an integrated commerce portfolio that includes point-of-sale capabilities and customer-facing digital experiences. Define priorities based on market opportunities, customer needs, business objectives, platform health, and user experience insights.

- Establish and continuously improve a scalable Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) and product operating model. Build repeatable processes for discovery, research, prioritization, roadmap planning, requirements management, launch readiness, and product performance measurement.

- Drive the transition from a custom-request-driven roadmap toward a strategic, product-led roadmap informed by market opportunities, user needs, competitive trends, and long-term business objectives.

- Lead the evolution of a connected commerce ecosystem spanning point-of-sale, self-service ordering, mobile applications, web ordering, and emerging digital engagement channels. Ensure a seamless and consistent experience across all touchpoints.

- Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Product Delivery, and UX teams to define scalable and maintainable solutions that balance innovation, reliability, performance, and customer value.

- Champion user experience modernization across both operator-facing and customer-facing products. Influence design strategy and user experience decisions that improve usability, accessibility, adoption, conversion, and customer satisfaction.

- Lead product strategy and execution for key modernization initiatives, including mobile applications, self-service solutions, digital ordering, and next-generation commerce experiences.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders. Regularly engage with customers to understand operational challenges, gather feedback, validate product direction, and communicate roadmap strategy.

- Develop a structured approach for gathering market intelligence, customer insights, competitive analysis, and performance metrics. Translate findings into actionable recommendations that influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities.

- Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to align product investments with market opportunities and customer needs. Effectively communicate product vision, strategy, priorities, and business outcomes across all levels of the organization.

- Provide thought leadership and industry expertise related to point-of-sale, digital ordering, customer engagement, omnichannel commerce, and emerging technologies. Identify opportunities to leverage innovation, including AI-enabled capabilities, where they create meaningful business and customer value.

- Not an exhaustive list; other duties as assigned.

What you'll bring:
- Bachelor's Degree

- Typically a minimum of 10 years of product management, product strategy, or related experience.

- Minimum of 5 years leading, mentoring, or managing Product Managers and cross-functional teams.

- Demonstrated experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and prioritization frameworks.

- Experience with Point of Sale, digital ordering, commerce, hospitality technology.

- Experience building scalable product management processes, operating models, or Product Development Lifecycle frameworks.

- Experience collaborating with Engineering, UX, Design, Delivery, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success organizations.

- Experience presenting product strategy, roadmaps, and business outcomes to executive stakeholders and customers.

It's a bonus if you have the following!
- Experience leading product organizations responsible for both platform capabilities and customer-facing digital experiences.

- Experience with self-service kiosks, mobile applications, web ordering, digital commerce, loyalty, or customer engagement solutions.

- Experience leading modernization initiatives involving mobile, UX transformation, or cloud-based platform evolution.

- Experience managing complex B2B SaaS, enterprise software, hospitality technology, or commerce platforms.

- Experience working in high-growth product organizations with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.

- Familiarity with AI-enabled products, conversational experiences, or data-driven product capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Master Data Management (MDM)
jobs.description:
Job Description
Ready to take your career global?
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a   Senior Technical Product Manager (MDM)  to join our ever-evolving   Data & AI team  and help shape the future of global commerce.
In this role, you will play a critical part in transforming Master Data Management (MDM) strategy into enterprise-wide outcomes that power analytics, reporting, risk management, compliance, and business operations. You will drive the delivery, adoption, and operationalization of trusted customer and merchant master data capabilities, enabling smarter decisions, stronger business performance, and scalable growth across Global Payments.
Working closely with architects, engineers, data modelers, governance teams, business stewards, and stakeholders across the enterprise, you will own product execution from roadmap planning through delivery and adoption. You will translate business priorities into scalable technical solutions, guide delivery teams, drive alignment across organizations, and ensure master data capabilities are embedded into the business processes and systems that depend on trusted data.
What you'll own
- Drive delivery and adoption of the Master Data Management roadmap , defining priorities, sequencing releases, and executing against strategic objectives that improve trusted customer and merchant data across the enterprise.

- Own and manage the product backlog , including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint commitments, dependencies, trade-offs, and release planning activities.

- Translate business, data, and stakeholder requirements into technical requirements and delivery plans , including data specifications, data contracts, integration requirements, and measurable outcomes.

- Lead the operationalization and adoption of master data capabilities  by integrating trusted master data into business workflows, onboarding processes, CRM platforms, analytics solutions, and enterprise applications through approaches such as search-before-create, publish/subscribe, and golden-record consumption patterns.

- Partner with architects, engineers, data modelers, and business stewards  to ensure scalable MDM solutions align with enterprise architecture, governance standards, and business objectives.

- Champion enterprise data quality, stewardship, and governance outcomes  by connecting data quality rules, stewardship processes, governance requirements, and scorecard metrics to business value and adoption goals.

- Define and monitor key performance indicators  such as data quality, duplicate reduction, match confidence, adoption, cycle time, and operational efficiency to demonstrate business value and delivery success.

- Lead Agile delivery execution  through backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, release management, and continuous improvement practices while maintaining accountability for delivery outcomes.

- Drive stakeholder communication and alignment  across product, business, onboarding, CRM, architecture, governance, analytics, and engineering teams through demos, roadmap updates, release communications, and executive readouts.

- Support testing, release readiness, and adoption activities  including UAT, SIT, training, documentation, knowledge transfer, and business enablement.

- Provide technical product leadership and mentorship  by promoting delivery best practices, coaching teams, and helping mature enterprise product management capabilities.

What you'll bring
- 8+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, Master Data Management, or enterprise data delivery, with proven ownership of technical roadmaps, backlogs, and execution outcomes.

- Deep understanding of Master Data Management concepts including golden records, entity resolution, survivorship, hierarchies, crosswalks, data quality, stewardship, and reference data management.

- Strong ability to translate business objectives into technical solutions, product requirements, data specifications, integration requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.

- Proven experience managing Agile delivery practices, including product backlogs, sprint execution, acceptance criteria, dependency management, release planning, and stakeholder prioritization.

- Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns including APIs, REST services, event-driven architecture, streaming concepts, and integration with CRM, ERP, onboarding, analytics, and cloud data platforms.

- Working knowledge of SQL, data profiling, data validation, matching logic, and data quality processes that support trusted enterprise data.

- Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills with the ability to build alignment across technical and business audiences.

- Experience collaborating with architects, engineers, data governance teams, stewards, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable enterprise data solutions.

- Ability to understand how master data supports enterprise operations, analytics, customer experience, onboarding, risk management, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven business initiatives.

- Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a focus on execution, adoption, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.

It's a bonus if you have
- Experience with enterprise Master Data Management platforms such as   Reltio   MDM solutions.

- Experience leading or supporting enterprise MDM modernization programs, platform migrations, convergence programs, and large-scale data transformation initiatives.

- Knowledge of cloud-based data ecosystems such as Snowflake, AWS, Azure, modern data architectures, and enterprise analytics platforms.

- Experience operationalizing master data capabilities across CRM, onboarding, customer lifecycle, and enterprise business processes.

- Knowledge of payments, merchant acquiring, financial services, merchant hierarchies, Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), risk, fraud, and regulatory compliance processes.

- Familiarity with data governance frameworks, stewardship operating models, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations.

- Experience establishing and measuring data quality scorecards, adoption metrics, stewardship KPIs, and business value outcomes.

jobs.description:
Chcesz rozwijać swoją karierę globalnie?

Zaznacz swoją obecność w jednej z największych firm w branży płatności. Poszukujemy Product Managera/ki, który/a dołączy do naszego dynamicznie rozwijającego się Biura Rozwoju Produktów w eService i pomoże kształtować przyszłość globalnego handlu.

eService jest liderem rynku akceptacji kart płatniczych i rozliczania transakcji elektronicznych w Polsce, a także największym dostawcą technologii w zakresie usług rozliczeniowych w Europie Środkowo-Wschodniej. Firma działa na rynku od prawie 25 lat i oferuje przedsiębiorcom omnichannelowe rozwiązania płatnicze zarówno dla stacjonarnych i mobilnych punktów usługowo-handlowych, jak i działalności online. W ofercie ma terminale POS i bramki płatnicze dla rozwiązań e-commerce i m-commerce. Firma wspiera promocję płatności bezgotówkowych w małych i średnich przedsiębiorstwach, a także w jednostkach samorządu terytorialnego i instytucjach publicznych. eService należy do Global Payments Inc. (NYSE: GPN) i PKO Banku Polskiego. Global Payments z siedzibą w Atlancie w stanie Georgia, zatrudnia około 27 000 pracowników na całym świecie, jest spółką z listy Fortune 500® i członkiem S&P 500. Prowadzi działalność o światowym zasięgu obejmującym Amerykę Północną, Europę, Azję i Pacyfik oraz Amerykę Łacińską.

Twoje obowiązki :
- Rozwój i zarządzanie ofertą produktową eService (eCommerce i POS), w tym tworzenie i realizacja roadmapy produktów
- Analiza rynku oraz potrzeb klientów i organizacji, wraz z rekomendowaniem nowych rozwiązań
- Pełnienie roli eksperta merytorycznego i wsparcie zespołów (m.in. sprzedaży) w zakresie produktów
- Przygotowywanie dokumentacji i materiałów produktowych (od koncepcji po wdrożenie)
- Wspieranie optymalizacji procesów biznesowych oraz bieżące zarządzanie operacyjne produktami

Twoje kompetencje :
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku oraz znajomość podstaw zarządzania projektami
- Rozwinięte umiejętności analityczne i swoboda pracy z danymi
- Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (min. B2)
- Wysokie umiejętności komunikacyjne, w tym zdolność tłumaczenia zagadnień technicznych na język biznesowy
- Dobra orientacja w aspektach technicznych produktów oraz proaktywne podejście do rozwiązywania problemów

Nasze inkluzywne i globalne zespoły wspólnie zwyciężają każdego dnia. Jesteśmy dumni, że mamy najlepsze umysły w branży, od których możesz się uczyć, rozwijając swoją karierę. Globalpayerzy myślą jak klient, działają jak właściciele i wygrywają jako jeden zespół. Są ciekawi i innowacyjni — zawsze szukają lepszych sposobów na osiąganie rezultatów. Wspieramy się nawzajem w podejmowaniu decyzji, a nasza pasja napędza doskonałość we wszystkim, co robimy.
